Implementation Plan ## Implementation plan for #10177: accept a stale final-CI merge ref when only default-branch syncs and resolver commits moved the base (Phase 10 / D10 of `docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md`) Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-9650` at `a0c7fe1a7f24b27ecac585fba44da4c2da24059a`. Integration branch mismatch: false. The plan's Phase 10 text was read from `isolated-base` (D10 at lines 80-87, item 10 at lines 208-211, Implementation Steps at lines 354-411). The script, its test and `agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md` are the same on the planning ref as on `isolated-base`. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - `tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py` - `scripts/stage_switches.json` - `README.md` - `agents.d/9602-final-ci-base-sync.md` - `agents.d/10177-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md` (new) - `changelog.d/10177-final-ci-sync-only-merge-ref.md` (new) ## Acceptance ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py::test_sync_only_stale_merge_ref_is_accepted red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py::test_default_branch_pr_stale_merge_ref_still_fails ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py::test_every_final_ci_checkout_is_followed_by_the_check red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.py::test_sync_only_switch_off_keeps_the_stale_exit ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_stage_switch_registry.py ACCEPTANCE: post-merge workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml ## Automation / wiring (§20.E) - **Kind of change:** only existing code changes. The existing script `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` gets one new function. No new script, no supervisor and no database work. - **Where it runs:** the existing step "Verify the final-CI merge ref is current". That step runs after each of the ten final-CI checkouts in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, on `workflow_dispatch` final CI. No job and no step is added (§26). Only one `env:` line is added to each of the ten steps. - **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry is needed. ## Conflict detection (read before implementing) 1. **The plan's line numbers are out of date.** The plan places the call at "today's `outcome=stale` exit at about :181" and says the loop reassigns `first` "at about :159". Those numbers come from before #9727, the local-merge fallback. On the planning ref: - when the refresh attempts run out, the script first builds the merge itself (`ci_final_merge_ref_merge_locally`, lines 449-453, `outcome=merged_locally`); - `outcome=stale` is now logged at only one place, lines 464-470, and only when the local merge cannot be built (`merge_base_too_deep`, `merge_fetch_failed`, `merge_tree_unsupported`, `merge_failed`); - `first` is reassigned at line 412. The existing stale exit at lines 464-470 is still "the stale exit after the refresh attempts have run out", so the new check goes there (D1). 2. **The issue's summary of the failure is no longer accurate.** It says the script "fails every final-CI job with `outcome=stale` whenever the merge-ref base is not the current tip". Since #9727 that happens only when the local merge cannot be built. The most likely remaining integration-branch case is `merge_base_too_deep`, where the head is far behind after many syncs. R7 is still open for that case, so the work is still useful, just narrower than the issue states. 3. **Two registry bullets for the same prefix.** `agents.d/9690-final-ci-local-merge.md:12` already holds a second `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF` "additions" bullet. As the issue directs, only the 9602 bullet is corrected in place. The 9690 bullet is left alone. 4. **Open pull requests touch the same files.** #10167, #10132, #10164, #10135, #10163, #10075 and #10074 touch `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. #10171, #10135, #10163 and #10173 touch `scripts/stage_switches.json`. Textual conflicts are possible, but the edits are additive one-line insertions. ## Functions or modules to implement ### `scripts/ci_final_merge_ref_fresh.sh` **a. Capture values before the refresh loop.** Directly after the not-a-merge check (around line 336), add two locals to `ci_final_merge_ref_main`: - `sync_only_tested_base="${first}"`. This is the first parent of the checked-out commit, read by `ci_final_merge_ref_parents HEAD` at line 330. The loop never reassigns it. - `sync_only_checked_out="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`. **b. Widen the existing `pulls/` read (line 337)** so it also returns `changed_files`, with no extra call. Use a filter such as `"\(.base.ref // "")\t\(.changed_files // "" | tostring)"` and read it with `IFS=$'\t' read -r base_ref sync_only_pr_changed_files`. The `base_ref` validation and the fail-open paths do not change. A missing `changed_files` only matters on the stale path. **c. New helper `ci_final_merge_ref_default_branch`.** It runs `git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD`, keeps `` from the line `ref: refs/heads/\tHEAD`, and validates it with the same rule as `base_ref` (`^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$`, no `..`, no leading `-`). It prints nothing on failure. **d. New function `ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only `.** It reads the PR number and `GITHUB_SHA` from the environment. It sets three globals: - `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_DETAIL` - `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_COMMITS` - `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_FILES` It returns 0 to accept and 1 to reject. It checks in this order and stops at the first failure: - **Pre-checks.** Each of these fails as `detail=api_error`: - `tip` must be 40 hex characters; if not, re-read it once with `ci_final_merge_ref_tip`; - `git rev-parse HEAD` must equal `sync_only_checked_out`; if not, check that commit out again with `git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout --quiet --detach --force` (D2); - HEAD's parents must be ` `; - the default branch must be readable. - **(0) Integration base only.** If `base_ref` equals the default branch, fail with `detail=default_base`. This step makes no API call. - **(1) Ancestry and range.** One `ci_final_merge_ref_api "compare/..." ` call. The jq filter emits: - one header line `Hstatustotal_commitslen(commits)len(files)`; - one line per commit, `Cshaparent_countparents[1].sha`, where the subject is the first line of `commit.message`, JSON-encoded; - one line per file, `F`, plus a line for `previous_filename` when `status=="renamed"`. Outcomes: - empty output, a missing header or non-numeric fields: `api_error`; - `status != ahead`: `not_ahead`; - `total_commits > 250`, `len(commits) != total_commits`, or `len(files) >= 300`: `truncated`. - **(2) Commit types.** One `compare/...` call with a filter that emits the header and commit SHAs. If `total_commits > 250` or `len(commits) != total_commits`, fail as `truncated`. Each commit from (1) must then be one of: - a commit in the default-branch set; - a commit with `parent_count == 2`, a subject exactly equal to `chore: sync into ` (compared after the same JSON encoding), and a second parent in the default-branch set; - a commit whose subject starts with `[ai-merge-resolve]`. Anything else fails as `foreign_commit`. - **(3) No overlap.** - `changed_files` must be a non-negative integer, otherwise `api_error`. - If it is above 3000, fail as `too_many_files` before any page is fetched. - Otherwise fetch pages 1 through `ceil(changed_files/100)` of `pulls//files?per_page=100&page=

`, with the same `filename` and `previous_filename` encoding. A failed page is `api_error`. If the total number of entries is not `changed_files`, fail as `truncated`. - Any shared entry between the two file sets is `file_overlap`. Use `sort -u` and `comm -12` on temporary files under `mktemp -d`, removed by `trap`. Never use `eval`. - **On accept,** set `_COMMITS` to `total_commits` and `_FILES` to the number of distinct file entries from (1). **e. Hook at the stale exit (lines 464-470).** Before the existing `::error::` lines: - Parse `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED:-true` with the same lowercase `true|1|yes|on` case as line 306. - If the switch is on and `ci_final_merge_ref_sync_only` returns 0: - log `ci_final_merge_ref_log stale_accepted sync_only_no_overlap "base= tested_base= tip= commits= files= ${pin_note}"`. The order of the fields named in the issue is kept; - when `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` is set, append one line saying the run tested base `` and that the sync commits up to `` touch none of the PR's files; - `return 0`. - Otherwise print today's `::error::` text unchanged, then the existing stale log line with ` detail=` added at the end. With the switch off, no `detail=` is added, so the line is identical to today's (D4). **f. Script header.** - Add a bullet that describes the stale-path acceptance. - In the `Env:` list, add `CI_FINAL_MERGE_REF_SYNC_ONLY_ACCEPT_ENABLED` (default `true`, parsed as true/1/yes/on) and `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`. - In the API budget paragraph, record up to 32 GETs per job: two compares plus at most 30 PR-files pages. These run only on the already-failing stale path and never on the fresh, refreshed or merged-locally paths. Note that condition 0 and a failed compare check stop before the files listing, that a typical PR needs one page, and that `changed_files` comes from the widened existing read. Add a comment saying which existing reads were checked: no earlier read covers compare or files data. - Extend the `Log:` line with `stale_accepted`, `sync_only_no_overlap`, `detail=`, `commits=` and `files=`. ### `.github/workflows/ci.yml` In each of the ten "Verify the final-CI merge ref is current" step `env:` blocks (lines 178, 924, 1754, 2065, 2504, 3331, 4520, 4836, 5048 and 5175
